groups.problem: Narrowing the BuildIndex cache lock to just the map write lets concurrent builds of the same key run, creating duplicate index instances and possibly opening the same on-disk directory twice.
groups.rationale: Both point at bleve.go lines 137-139. Both describe how losing whole-function serialization allows duplicate concurrent builds for one key, and both propose a per-key lock or re-check as the fix.

problems: NewResourceServer now initializes eagerly and returns nil on any index build failure, which changes the constructor's contract from lazy, per-request errors to fail-fast.
Because Init is guarded by sync.Once, the internal call uses up the once, so the context a caller later passes to Init is silently ignored.
